text:
Cheng: Quick RFC follow-up — thinking about deterministic fingerprinting for routing affinity vs dynamic penaltying. idea: compute a stable request_fingerprint so we can keep KV-cache affinity + batching, but still apply transient penalties for overloaded variants.

Mira: +1 on keeping sticky affinity. can you sketch what goes in the fingerprint? tenant_id + model_family + prefix_hash? :thinking_face:

Cheng: exactly. proposal: fingerprint = sha256(tenant_id || route_name || prefix_first_128_chars). we only use it for affinity selection (shard placement + cache key). penalties should be separate multiplier applied after affinity selection.

Owen: curious about cache correctness: if penalty causes routing to fallback to another variant, do we risk cache misses and confusing KV state?

Cheng: good call. plan: runtime keeps two-step decision: 1) pick_affinity_variant(fingerprint) 2) apply_penalty_mask(variant, penalty_score) -> if masked then pick_fallback_variant_by_policy. we never mutate the KV cache for the source variant when penalized — we instead route to fallback that may have empty cache.

Laura: that means degraded perf on fallback until its cache warms. ok tradeoff. we should surface a hint so higher-level clients can decide to stall the request and wait for a warmer variant (optional).

Mira: exposing hint is useful. maybe a field in decision proto: { fingerprint_used: bool, affinity_variant: string, penalty_applied: float, routed_variant: string, hint: string }

Cheng: yeah — sample proto in mind:
```
message RouteDecision {
  bool fingerprint_used = 1;
  string affinity_variant = 2;
  double penalty_applied = 3;
  string routed_variant = 4;
  string hint = 5; // e.g., \"fallback-warmed\" or \"fallback-empty-cache\"
}
```

Owen: how do we prevent oscillation where penalty flips between variants rapidly? need smoothing window and hysteresis.

Cheng: propose two controls: penalty_ttl (seconds) and penalty_decay_half_life. penalties are time-decayed rather than instant removal. and add a min_stable_time_for_variant switch to prevent immediate re-affinity for X seconds after a change.

Laura: ops implications: telemetry should include "penalty_events" per tenant + variant so SRE can see thrash. also we need a fast path to clear penalties manually for debugging.

ops-bot: note: runbook entry created: docs/runbooks/routing-penalties.md (draft) :white_check_mark:

Mira: policy DSL question — where do we express affinity vs penalty semantics? in the policy layer or runtime? my vote: policy layer expresses intent (weights, tiers, soft_preempt), runtime translates to fingerprint affinity + penalty application. keeps policy compact.

Cheng: agreed. sample policy fragment:
```
policy "tenant_default" {
  route "text-gen" {
    affinity_shard: "tenant_hash:16"
    prefer_tier: ["dedicated", "hosted"]
    soft_preempt { threshold_qps: 500 penalty: 0.7 ttl: 30s }
  }
}
```

Owen: question on observability: decision logs need to be compact but queryable. include only hashes and variant ids by default, full proto on sample traces.

Laura: agree, also add counters for "routed_from_penalty" and "affinity_hits". these will help us tune shard size and penalty thresholds.

Mira: any perf impact on decision latency? two-step pick + penalty check should be microseconds but watch out for crypto (sha256) cost — maybe use xxhash for speed and accept lower collision resistance.

Cheng: we'll benchmark. initial plan: xxhash64 for runtime affinity key, keep sha256 only for audit/logs if needed.

Owen: edge case: cold-starts for new variants in a region — we should bias away from a brand-new variant until it reports healthy cache stats. add a warmup_score metric.

Cheng: adding warmup_score to runtime is simple: variant_state { cache_fill_pct, recent_success_qps } -> warmup_score = f(cache, qps). policy can define min_warmup_threshold.

Laura: sounds actionable. next steps?

Cheng: I'll spin up a small RFC PR that: 1) defines RouteDecision proto, 2) adds fingerprint calculation helper + option to toggle sha256/xxhash, 3) implements penalty_ttl + decay, 4) telemetry counters. planning to prototype in the routing sandbox.

Mira: please tag me and @Owen in the PR. I'll review policy DSL bits.

Owen: will help with telemetry + benchmarks.

Laura: I'll draft runbook and add ops-bot note to the PR.

Cheng: thanks all. landing plan: prototype -> canary on low-QPS tenants -> widen. :rocket:
